title: Bariatric surgery: Efficacy of a postoperative follow up program using a mobile Application in regards of weight loss after bariatric surgery
summary: The aim of this study is to confirm the feasibility and safety of a follow-up program with a smartphone application. Patients who have recently had bariatric surgery are included. For this purpose, patients are randomly divided into two groups. One group receives normal follow-up care in person, the other group receives a mobile phone app for follow-up care. One year after the operation, all patients are followed up in the outpatient clinic.
conditions: Adipositas durch übermäßige Kalorienzufuhr: Adipositas Grad III (WHO) bei Patienten von 18 Jahren und älter, Body-Mass-Index [BMI] von 40 bis unter 50
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Patients with a smartphone with internet access and able to use it
• Patients who underwent a primary bariatric surgery within the last two weeks
• Age ≥ 18 years
• Written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
• Patients with language barrier or impaired mental state
• Expected lack of compliance
• Serious early complications (grade III and IV according to the Clavien-Dindo classification) up to the first follow-up appointment
• Redo surgeries
• Not possible to attend the in-person visit at the end of the trial (one year after surgery)
